questions.question: What is our total approved spend?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(line_total) AS total_spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line

questions.question: How much did we spend with each vendor?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT v.vendor_name, sum(f.line_total) AS spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_vendor v USING (vendor_key) GROUP BY v.vendor_name

questions.question: Which vendor did we spend the most money with?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT v.vendor_name FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_vendor v USING (vendor_key) GROUP BY v.vendor_name ORDER BY sum(f.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many approved receipts are there?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts FROM mart.fact_purchase_line

questions.question: What was our total spend in each month?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.year, d.month, sum(f.line_total) AS spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.full_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.year, d.month

questions.question: Which month had the highest spend?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.month_name FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.full_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_name ORDER BY sum(f.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are our top 5 items by spend?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT i.item_name FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.item_name <> 'UNMAPPED' GROUP BY i.item_name ORDER BY sum(f.line_total) DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many different items have we bought?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.item_key) AS items FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.item_name <> 'UNMAPPED'

questions.question: What is the average amount we spend per receipt?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT avg(receipt_spend) AS avg_spend FROM (SELECT receipt_id, sum(line_total) AS receipt_spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line GROUP BY receipt_id) r

questions.question: How much have we spent on items in the Meat category?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(f.line_total) AS spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.category = 'Meat'

questions.question: How much did we spend in each item category?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT i.category, sum(f.line_total) AS spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.category

questions.question: What is the latest price per pound of chicken breast at each vendor?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (vendor_name) vendor_name, unit_price FROM mart.v_price_history WHERE item_name = 'chicken breast' ORDER BY vendor_name, purchase_date DESC

questions.question: Which items had a price increase alert?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT item_name FROM mart.v_price_alerts

questions.question: Which supplier is cheapest for canola oil right now?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT cheapest_vendor FROM mart.v_supplier_savings WHERE item_name = 'canola oil'

questions.question: What is the total estimated monthly saving if we bought every compared item from the cheapest supplier?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(estimated_monthly_savings) AS savings FROM mart.v_supplier_savings

questions.question: How many pounds of chicken breast have we bought in total?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(f.standard_quantity) AS pounds FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.item_name = 'chicken breast'

questions.question: How much did we spend with Sunrise Meat Co. in September 2026?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(f.line_total) AS spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_vendor v USING (vendor_key) JOIN mart.dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Sunrise Meat Co.' AND d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 9

questions.question: Which vendors do we buy jasmine rice from?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.vendor_name FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_vendor v USING (vendor_key) JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.item_name = 'jasmine rice'

questions.question: How many receipts do we have from each vendor?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT v.vendor_name, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_vendor v USING (vendor_key) GROUP BY v.vendor_name

questions.question: What was the most expensive single line on any receipt?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT max(line_total) AS biggest_line FROM mart.fact_purchase_line

questions.question: What is the average price per pound we paid for yellow onions?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(f.line_total) / sum(f.standard_quantity) AS avg_price FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.item_name = 'yellow onions' AND f.standard_quantity > 0

questions.question: How much did we spend on Produce in July 2026?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT sum(f.line_total) AS spend FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) JOIN mart.dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE i.category = 'Produce' AND d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 7

questions.question: On which day of the week do we spend the most?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT d.day_of_week FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.full_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.day_of_week ORDER BY sum(f.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many purchase lines are there in each item category?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT i.category, count(*) AS lines FROM mart.fact_purchase_line f JOIN mart.dim_item i USING (item_key) WHERE i.category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.category

questions.question: Which items do we buy from more than one supplier?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT item_name FROM mart.v_supplier_savings
